notes.subject: ותורך
notes.rationale: ירה hiphil: 'bai skulim yu' (KJV/ASV) o 'bai soim yu' (ylt/bsb) — tupela i save togat long Tpi.

notes.subject: דבר
notes.rationale: Geneva/KJV ritim 'word of truth'; Tok Pisin 'tok bilong emet' — Hebrew דבר em i 'tok/mate' olgeta.

notes.subject: king
notes.rationale: Tok i go stret long king — nem namba tu long Tok Pisin (ata bilong).

translation: Long hadar bilong yu, raun i go het, bilong tok bilong emet, na bilong anenua bilong tsedek; na han kapus bilong yu bai skulim yu long ol samting i mekim ol man pret.
